doors.note: US: 3 own doors — South Coast Plaza (Costa Mesa), 650 Madison Ave (New York), Bal Harbour Shops — and 1 concession, 'Bloomingdale's Roger Vivier' at 59th Street. World: 104 boutiques; about 40 sit inside department stores (David Jones, Holt Renfrew, Japanese and Korean department stores, etc.). No phones or US states in the list; the Madison entry carries two ZIPs. No stockist list. Paris label (Tod's group, per the site's cookie text).
